traits.silhouette: A tall (about 3 m) hovering figure with no legs: a huge pointed hood behind the head, square shoulders, a narrow waist and a long pleated skirt that flares to the hem, floating a little off the ground.
traits.head: A small round face set in front of a tall spade- or leaf-shaped hood that rises well above it to a point; two big round glowing eyes (red on the dark figure, yellow on the town chair), a small nose and mouth.
traits.limbs: No legs. Thin, spindly arms from the shoulders, bent, ending in long clawed fingers held out from the body.
traits.hide: Smooth, like a suit or armour: a hard square chest plate, ribbed rings at the waist, deep vertical pleats down the skirt; the hood has a serrated or rayed edge.
traits.colours: Either dark slate grey all over with glowing red eyes, or the 1952 town colours: a red face and hood, a green body and skirt, a pale blue-white collar.
child: the pointed spade hood behind the head
